<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Cardápio de Natal Laemy Doces</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@1,9..144,600..800&family=Quicksand:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap">
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--green:#04301a;--green-2:#0b4126;--red:#7a1209;--red-2:#92200f;--gold:#ffcf6b;--cream:#fbeed4;--muted:#d9c9a6;--line:rgba(255,207,107,.3);--card:rgba(0,0,0,.24);--bad:#ffb4a8;--font-display:"Fraunces",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;--font-body:"Quicksand",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;height:100%;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--green);color:var(--cream);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body.lock{overflow:hidden}
body.has-bar{padding-bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px))}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:60;background:var(--green)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*{transition:none!important}}
a{color:var(--gold)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:6px}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-block:12px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.brand img{width:46px;height:46px;flex:none}
.brand b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;font-size:1.35rem;color:var(--gold);white-space:nowrap}
.cart-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;font-weight:700;min-height:44px}
.cart-btn .n{background:var(--gold);color:var(--red);border-radius:999px;min-width:24px;height:24px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:.85rem;padding:0 6px}
.hero{background:radial-gradient(120% 90% at 85% 0%,var(--red-2) 0%,var(--red) 45%,#4d0a05 100%)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;gap:28px;align-items:center;padding-block:44px 52px}
.eyebrow{font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--gold);margin:0 0 8px}
.hero h1{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:600;line-height:.95;font-size:clamp(1.6rem,5vw,2.4rem);text-wrap:balance}
.hero h1 em{display:block;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(4.4rem,17vw,8rem);color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:-.02em;text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.hero p.lead{max-width:34ch;font-size:1.1rem;margin:16px 0 22px}
.cta-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 22px;border-radius:999px;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;text-decoration:none}
.btn.solid{background:var(--gold);color:var(--red)}
.btn.solid:hover{background:#ffdb8f}
.btn[aria-disabled="true"]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:22px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none}
.chips li{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:5px 12px;font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);background:rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.hero-photos{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding-inline:20px}
.hero-photos .ph{width:clamp(96px,24vw,178px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:4px solid var(--gold);background:var(--green);flex:none;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.hero-photos .ph+.ph{margin-left:-22px}
.hero-photos .ph:nth-child(2){transform:translateY(-18px);z-index:1;width:clamp(110px,28vw,206px)}
.ph img,.gphoto img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.notice{background:var(--gold);color:#3a0c05}
.notice .wrap{padding-block:12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px 14px;align-items:baseline;font-weight:600}
.tabs{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:20;background:var(--green);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.tabs .wrap{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow-x:auto;padding-block:10px;scrollbar-width:none}
.tabs .wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tabs a{flex:none;text-decoration:none;color:var(--cream);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 16px;font-weight:600;min-height:40px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center}
.tabs a:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold)}
.band.green{background:var(--green)}
.band.red{background:var(--red)}
.band .wrap{padding-block:48px}
.ghead{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:24px}
.gphoto{width:clamp(96px,26vw,140px);aspect-ratio:1;flex:none;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;border:4px solid #0d6b38;background:var(--green)}
.ghead h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(2.2rem,8vw,3.4rem);line-height:1;text-wrap:balance}
.ghead h2 small{display:block;font-size:.5em;font-weight:600;margin-top:4px;color:var(--cream)}
.ghead p{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--muted);max-width:46ch}
.ghead p.fine{font-size:.85rem;font-style:italic}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(100%,290px),1fr));gap:16px}
.item{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.item .pic{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover;border-radius:10px;display:block}
.item h3{margin:2px 0 0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;font-size:1.6rem;color:var(--gold);line-height:1.1}
.item .desc{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.vars{list-style:none;margin:4px 0 0;padding:0}
.var{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:6px 10px;padding:10px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.var .lbl{flex:1 1 76px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;min-width:0}
.var .lbl small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem}
.price{font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}
.ask-row{margin:0;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--line);color:var(--muted);font-size:.95rem}
.step{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:2px}
.step button{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--gold);background:transparent;color:var(--gold);font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0}
.step button:hover{background:rgba(255,207,107,.16)}
.step output{min-width:26px;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.step.on output{color:var(--gold)}
.how h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);font-size:clamp(2rem,7vw,3rem)}
.how ol{list-style:none;counter-reset:s;margin:20px 0 0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(min(100%,240px),1fr));gap:16px}
.how li{counter-increment:s;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;background:var(--card)}
.how li::before{content:counter(s);display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--gold);color:var(--red);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:10px}
.how li b{display:block;font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:2px}
.foot{background:#021f10}
.foot .wrap{padding-block:36px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:20px 40px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
.foot img{width:72px;height:72px}
.foot p{margin:0 0 4px}
.fbrand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
.fbrand b{font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--gold)}
.copy{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.copy button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:4px 12px;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--gold)}
.bar{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:25;background:linear-gradient(to top,#021f10 70%,rgba(2,31,16,0));padding:18px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
.bar .btn{width:100%;max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.drawer[hidden],.bar[hidden],[hidden]{display:none!important}
.drawer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50}
.scrim{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62)}
.panel{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;max-height:94vh;max-height:94dvh;overflow-y:auto;background:var(--green-2);border-radius:20px 20px 0 0;border-top:2px solid var(--gold);padding:16px max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px)) calc(28px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px))}
@media (min-width:760px){.panel{top:0;left:auto;width:480px;max-height:none;border-radius:0;border-top:0;border-left:2px solid var(--gold)}}
.phead{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:8px}
.phead h2{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);font-size:2rem}
.x{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--line);background:transparent;font-size:1.3rem}
.lines{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.line{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px 12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px dashed var(--line)}
.line .nm{font-weight:700}
.line .nm small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}
.line .lp{grid-column:1;color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.line .step{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/span 2}
.totals{margin:12px 0 4px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:var(--card)}
.totals div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:2px 0;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.totals .big{font-size:1.2rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--gold)}
.totals .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.empty{padding:24px 0;color:var(--muted)}
form.order{margin-top:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
form.order h3{margin:6px 0 0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-style:italic;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--gold)}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;min-width:0}
.field label,.field legend{font-weight:700;font-size:.92rem}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{font:inherit;color:var(--cream);background:rgba(0,0,0,.28);border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:11px 12px;min-height:46px;width:100%}
.field select option{color:#222}
.field textarea{min-height:80px;resize:vertical}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);outline:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(255,207,107,.3)}
.field[data-bad] input,.field[data-bad] textarea{border-color:var(--bad)}
.err{margin:0;color:var(--bad);font-size:.85rem}
.err:empty{display:none}
.row2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}
@media (max-width:460px){.row2{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
fieldset.field{border:0;padding:0;margin:0}
.seg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.seg label{position:relative;font-weight:600}
.seg input{position:absolute;opacity:0;inset:0}
.seg span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:46px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.2);text-align:center;padding:6px}
.seg input:checked+span{background:var(--gold);color:var(--red);border-color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}
.seg input:focus-visible+span{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.help{margin:0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--muted)}
.status{margin:0;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(255,207,107,.14);border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.92rem}
.status:empty{display:none}
details.msg summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;color:var(--gold);padding:6px 0}
details.msg textarea{width:100%;min-height:200px;font:.85rem/1.45 ui-monospace,Menlo,Consolas,monospace;color:var(--cream);background:rgba(0,0,0,.3);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px}
.linkbtn{background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted);text-decoration:underline;padding:6px 0;align-self:flex-start}
@media (max-width:720px){.hero .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding-block:32px 44px}.hero-photos{order:-1;padding-top:18px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="top"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="brand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="" width="46" height="46"><b>Laemy Doces</b></div>
  <button class="cart-btn" id="open-cart" type="button" aria-haspopup="dialog">Meu pedido <span class="n" id="cart-n">0</span></button>
</div></header>

<section class="hero" aria-labelledby="h1"><div class="wrap">
  <div>
    <p class="eyebrow">Encomendas de fim de ano</p>
    <h1 id="h1">Cardápio de <em>Natal</em></h1>
    <p class="lead">Doce é ainda melhor no Natal! Escolha os doces, marque o dia da retirada ou da entrega e envie o pedido para a gente pelo WhatsApp.</p>
    <div class="cta-row">
      <a class="btn solid" href="#alfajor">Escolher doces</a>
      <button class="btn" type="button" id="hero-cart">Ver meu pedido</button>
    </div>
    <ul class="chips"><li>Retirada ou entrega</li><li>Sinal de 50% para confirmar</li></ul>
  </div>
  <div class="hero-photos" aria-hidden="true">
    <div class="ph"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div>
    <div class="ph"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div>
    <div class="ph"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt=""></div>
  </div>
</div></section>

<div class="notice" role="note"><div class="wrap"><strong>Atenção:</strong><span id="deadline-text">Para confirmar o pedido, pague 50% de sinal até 10/12. Os 50% restantes são pagos na entrega ou retirada.</span></div></div>

<nav class="tabs" aria-label="Categorias do cardápio"><div class="wrap" id="tabs"></div></nav>
<main id="menu"></main>

<section class="band red how" id="como"><div class="wrap">
  <h2>Como pedir</h2>
  <ol>
    <li><b>Monte o pedido</b>Escolha as quantidades no cardápio e abra Meu pedido.</li>
    <li><b>Escolha data e forma</b>Informe se vai retirar ou receber em casa e a data desejada.</li>
    <li><b>Envie pelo WhatsApp</b>O pedido vai pronto no texto. Nós confirmamos a data e o horário com você.</li>
    <li><b>Pague o sinal</b>50% até 10/12 confirma o pedido. O restante é pago na entrega ou retirada.</li>
  </ol>
</div></section>

<footer class="foot"><div class="wrap">
  <div class="fbrand">
    <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Laemy Doces" width="72" height="72">
    <div><p><b>Com carinho, Laemy Doces!</b></p><p style="color:var(--muted)">Desejamos a você e sua família um Natal cheio de amor, paz e união.</p></div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <p>WhatsApp: <span class="copy"><b>(61) 99567-4887</b><button type="button" data-copy="(61) 99567-4887">Copiar</button></span></p>
    <p>Instagram: <a href="https://www.instagram.com/laemydoces/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">@laemydoces</a></p>
  </div>
</div></footer>

<div class="bar" id="bar" hidden><button class="btn solid" type="button" id="bar-btn"><span id="bar-left">Ver pedido</span><span id="bar-right"></span></button></div>

<div class="drawer" id="drawer" hidden>
  <div class="scrim" id="scrim"></div>
  <section class="panel" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="dt">
    <div class="phead"><h2 id="dt">Meu pedido</h2><button class="x" id="close" type="button" aria-label="Fechar pedido">&times;</button></div>
    <div id="empty" class="empty" hidden>
      <p>Seu pedido está vazio. Escolha os doces no cardápio e volte aqui para enviar.</p>
      <button class="btn" type="button" id="back">Voltar ao cardápio</button>
    </div>
    <div id="filled" hidden>
      <ul class="lines" id="lines"></ul>
      <div class="totals" id="totals"></div>
      <button class="linkbtn" id="clear" type="button">Limpar pedido</button>
      <form class="order" id="form" novalidate>
        <h3>Seus dados</h3>
        <div class="field" id="w-nome"><label for="f-nome">Nome</label><input id="f-nome" name="nome" autocomplete="name" required><p class="err" id="e-nome"></p></div>
        <div class="field" id="w-tel"><label for="f-tel">Telefone com DDD</label><input id="f-tel" name="tel" type="tel" inputmode="tel" autocomplete="tel" placeholder="(61) 99999-9999" required><p class="err" id="e-tel"></p></div>
        <h3>Entrega ou retirada</h3>
        <fieldset class="field"><legend>Como você quer receber?</legend>
          <div class="seg">
            <label><input type="radio" name="tipo" value="Retirada" checked><span>Vou retirar</span></label>
            <label><input type="radio" name="tipo" value="Entrega"><span>Entrega</span></label>
          </div>
        </fieldset>
        <div class="field" id="w-end" hidden>
          <label for="f-end">Endereço de entrega</label>
          <textarea id="f-end" name="end" autocomplete="street-address" placeholder="Rua, número, quadra, bairro e ponto de referência"></textarea>
          <p class="help">A taxa de entrega é combinada com a Laemy pelo WhatsApp.</p>
          <p class="err" id="e-end"></p>
        </div>
        <div class="row2">
          <div class="field" id="w-data"><label for="f-data">Data desejada</label><input id="f-data" name="data" type="date" required><p class="err" id="e-data"></p></div>
          <div class="field"><label for="f-per">Preferência de horário</label>
            <select id="f-per" name="per"><option>Manhã (8h às 12h)</option><option>Tarde (12h às 17h)</option><option>Noite (17h às 20h)</option></select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <p class="help">Data e horário são pedidos de preferência. A Laemy confirma com você pelo WhatsApp.</p>
        <div class="field"><label for="f-obs">Observações (opcional)</label><textarea id="f-obs" name="obs" placeholder="Alergias, recado no cartão, horário ideal..."></textarea></div>
        <p class="err" id="e-cart" role="alert"></p>
        <a class="btn solid" id="wa" href="#" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Enviar pedido pelo WhatsApp</a>
        <p class="status" id="status" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
        <details class="msg">
          <summary>Ver ou copiar a mensagem do pedido</summary>
          <textarea id="msg" readonly aria-label="Mensagem do pedido"></textarea>
          <button class="btn" type="button" id="copy-msg" style="margin-top:8px">Copiar pedido</button>
        </details>
        <p class="help">O WhatsApp abre com o pedido escrito. Você só precisa tocar em enviar. Se não abrir, copie o pedido e mande para <b>(61) 99567-4887</b>.</p>
      </form>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  "use strict";
  var CONFIG = { whatsapp: "5561995674887", phoneLabel: "(61) 99567-4887", depositDeadline: [2026, 12, 10], firstDate: "2026-12-01", lastDate: "2026-12-25" };
  var IMG = {
    alfajor: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", trufa: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", brigadeiro: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    tmorango: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", tmaracuja: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", touro: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", tuva: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
    guva: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", gmorango: "data:image/jpeg;base64,", rabanada: "data:image/jpeg;base64,"
  };
  function v(id, label, note, price) { return { id: id, label: label, note: note, price: price }; }
  var GROUPS = [
    { id: "alfajor", title: "Alfajor", img: IMG.alfajor, sub: "Biscoito Maria, doce de leite e cobertura de chocolate.",
      items: [ { id: "alfajor", name: "Alfajor", desc: "Biscoito Maria, doce de leite e cobertura de chocolate.", vars: [
        v("un", "Unidade", "", 4.99), v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 unidades", 249.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 unidades", 349.99) ] } ] },
    { id: "trufa", title: "Trufa", subtitle: "20g", img: IMG.trufa, sub: "Escolha o sabor e a quantidade: meio cento ou cento.",
      items: [
        { id: "uva", name: "Surpresa de uva", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 99.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 199.99) ] },
        { id: "morango", name: "Surpresa de morango", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 99.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 199.99) ] },
        { id: "ninho", name: "Ninho", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 74.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 149.99) ] },
        { id: "brigadeiro", name: "Brigadeiro", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 74.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 149.99) ] },
        { id: "maracuja", name: "Maracujá", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 99.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 199.99) ] },
        { id: "ferrero", name: "Ferrero Rocher", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 149.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 299.99) ] }
      ] },
    { id: "brigadeiro", title: "Brigadeiro", img: IMG.brigadeiro, sub: "Escolha o sabor e a quantidade: meio cento ou cento.",
      items: [
        { id: "brigadeiro", name: "Brigadeiro", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 59.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 119.99) ] },
        { id: "ninho", name: "Ninho", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 59.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 119.99) ] },
        { id: "beijinho", name: "Beijinho", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 62.49), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 124.99) ] },
        { id: "pacoca", name: "Paçoca", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 64.99), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 129.99) ] },
        { id: "cajuzinho", name: "Cajuzinho", vars: [ v("mc", "Meio cento", "50 un", 67.49), v("c", "Cento", "100 un", 134.99) ] }
      ] },
    { id: "travessas", title: "Travessas", sub: "Em dois tamanhos: 1 litro e 2 litros.", fine: "Imagens meramente ilustrativas.",
      items: [
        { id: "morango", name: "Morango", img: IMG.tmorango, vars: [ v("1l", "1 litro", "", 39.99), v("2l", "2 litros", "", 64.99) ] },
        { id: "maracuja", name: "Maracujá", img: IMG.tmaracuja, vars: [ v("1l", "1 litro", "", 35.49), v("2l", "2 litros", "", 54.99) ] },
        { id: "ourobranco", name: "Ouro Branco", img: IMG.touro, vars: [ v("1l", "1 litro", "", 44.99), v("2l", "2 litros", "", 84.99) ] },
        { id: "uva", name: "Uva", img: IMG.tuva, vars: [ v("1l", "1 litro", "", 34.99), v("2l", "2 litros", "", 54.99) ] }
      ] },
    { id: "brownie", title: "Brownie Guirlanda", subtitle: "18 cm", fine: "Imagens meramente ilustrativas.",
      items: [
        { id: "uva", name: "Uva", img: IMG.guva, vars: [ v("18", "Guirlanda 18 cm", "", 84.99) ] },
        { id: "morango", name: "Morango", img: IMG.gmorango, vars: [ v("18", "Guirlanda 18 cm", "", 94.99) ] }
      ] },
    { id: "rabanada", title: "Rabanada",
      items: [ { id: "rabanada", name: "Rabanada", img: IMG.rabanada, pos: "50% 62%", vars: [
        v("6", "Meia dúzia", "6 unidades", 44.99), v("10", "Uma dezena", "10 unidades", 74.99), v("12", "Uma dúzia", "12 unidades", 84.99) ] } ] }
  ];

  var brl = function (n) { return n.toLocaleString("pt-BR", { style: "currency", currency: "BRL" }); };
  var $ = function (s, r) { return (r || document).querySelector(s); };
  var $$ = function (s, r) { return Array.prototype.slice.call((r || document).querySelectorAll(s)); };
  var STORE = "laemy-natal-2026";

  var LINES = {};
  GROUPS.forEach(function (g) {
    g.items.forEach(function (it) {
      it.vars.forEach(function (x) {
        var key = g.id + "." + it.id + "." + x.id;
        var name = (g.id === "trufa" ? "Trufa " : g.id === "brigadeiro" ? "Brigadeiro " : g.id === "travessas" ? "Travessa " : g.id === "brownie" ? "Brownie Guirlanda " : "") + it.name;
        if (g.id === "brigadeiro" && it.id === "brigadeiro") name = "Brigadeiro tradicional";
        LINES[key] = { key: key, name: name, label: x.label, note: x.note, price: x.price };
      });
    });
  });

  var cart = {};
  try {
    var saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
    if (saved.cart) Object.keys(saved.cart).forEach(function (k) { if (LINES[k] && LINES[k].price != null && saved.cart[k] > 0) cart[k] = saved.cart[k]; });
  } catch (e) {}
  function persist() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify({ cart: cart, nome: $("#f-nome").value, tel: $("#f-tel").value })); } catch (e) {}
  }

  function stepper(key) {
    return '<div class="step"><button type="button" data-act="dec" data-key="' + key + '" aria-label="Diminuir">&minus;</button>' +
      '<output data-out="' + key + '">0</output><button type="button" data-act="inc" data-key="' + key + '" aria-label="Aumentar">+</button></div>';
  }
  function askLink(name) {
    var t = "Olá! Quero saber o preço de: " + name + " (cardápio de Natal).";
    return '<a href="https://wa.me/' + CONFIG.whatsapp + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(t) + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Perguntar o preço no WhatsApp</a>';
  }
  function itemHTML(g, it) {
    var h = '<article class="item">';
    if (it.img) h += '<img class="pic" src="' + it.img + '" alt="' + g.title + " " + it.name + '" loading="lazy"' + (it.pos ? ' style="object-position:' + it.pos + '"' : "") + ">";
    h += "<h3>" + it.name + "</h3>";
    if (it.desc) h += '<p class="desc">' + it.desc + "</p>";
    if (it.ask) {
      h += '<p class="ask-row">Preço ainda não definido. ' + askLink(g.title + " " + it.name) + "</p>";
    } else {
      h += '<ul class="vars">';
      it.vars.forEach(function (x) {
        var key = g.id + "." + it.id + "." + x.id;
        h += '<li class="var"><div class="lbl">' + x.label + (x.note ? "<small>" + x.note + "</small>" : "") + '</div><div class="price">' + brl(x.price) + "</div>" + stepper(key) + "</li>";
      });
      h += "</ul>";
    }
    return h + "</article>";
  }
  function buildMenu() {
    var tabs = "", out = "";
    GROUPS.forEach(function (g, i) {
      tabs += '<a href="#' + g.id + '">' + g.title.replace("Brownie Guirlanda", "Brownie") + "</a>";
      out += '<section class="band ' + (i % 2 ? "red" : "green") + '" id="' + g.id + '" style="scroll-margin-top:' + 56 + 'px"><div class="wrap"><div class="ghead">';
      if (g.img) out += '<div class="gphoto" aria-hidden="true"><img src="' + g.img + '" alt="" loading="lazy"></div>';
      out += "<div><h2>" + g.title + (g.subtitle ? "<small>" + g.subtitle + "</small>" : "") + "</h2>";
      if (g.sub) out += "<p>" + g.sub + "</p>";
      if (g.fine) out += '<p class="fine">' + g.fine + "</p>";
      out += '</div></div><div class="grid">';
      g.items.forEach(function (it) { out += itemHTML(g, it); });
      out += "</div></div></section>";
    });
    $("#tabs").innerHTML = tabs;
    $("#menu").innerHTML = out;
  }

  function count() { return Object.keys(cart).reduce(function (a, k) { return a + cart[k]; }, 0); }
  function totalCents() { return Object.keys(cart).reduce(function (a, k) { return a + Math.round(LINES[k].price * 100) * cart[k]; }, 0); }
  function total() { return totalCents() / 100; }
  function setQty(key, q) {
    q = Math.max(0, Math.min(99, q));
    if (q === 0) delete cart[key]; else cart[key] = q;
    sync(); persist();
  }
  function paintSteppers(root) {
    $$("[data-out]", root).forEach(function (o) {
      var q = cart[o.getAttribute("data-out")] || 0;
      o.textContent = q; o.parentNode.classList.toggle("on", q > 0);
    });
  }
  function sync() {
    paintSteppers(document);
    var n = count();
    $("#cart-n").textContent = n;
    $("#bar").hidden = n === 0;
    document.body.classList.toggle("has-bar", n > 0);
    $("#bar-left").textContent = "Ver pedido (" + n + (n === 1 ? " item)" : " itens)");
    $("#bar-right").textContent = brl(total());
    if (!$("#drawer").hidden) renderCart();
  }
  function split() {
    var c = totalCents(), s = Math.round(c / 2);
    return { t: c / 100, sinal: s / 100, rest: (c - s) / 100 };
  }
  function renderCart() {
    var keys = Object.keys(cart);
    $("#empty").hidden = keys.length > 0;
    $("#filled").hidden = keys.length === 0;
    if (!keys.length) return;
    var h = "";
    keys.forEach(function (k) {
      var L = LINES[k];
      h += '<li class="line"><div class="nm">' + L.name + "<small>" + L.label + (L.note ? " · " + L.note : "") + "</small></div>" +
        '<div class="lp">' + cart[k] + " × " + brl(L.price) + " = " + brl(L.price * cart[k]) + "</div>" + stepper(k) + "</li>";
    });
    $("#lines").innerHTML = h;
    var s = split();
    $("#totals").innerHTML = '<div class="big"><span>Total</span><span>' + brl(s.t) + "</span></div>" +
      '<div class="sub"><span>Sinal de 50% (confirma o pedido)</span><span>' + brl(s.sinal) + "</span></div>" +
      '<div class="sub"><span>Restante na entrega/retirada</span><span>' + brl(s.rest) + "</span></div>";
    paintSteppers($("#lines"));
    updateWa();
  }

  function val(id) { return $(id).value.trim(); }
  function tipo() { return $('input[name="tipo"]:checked').value; }
  function fmtDate(iso) {
    if (!iso) return "";
    var p = iso.split("-"), d = new Date(+p[0], +p[1] - 1, +p[2]);
    var s = d.toLocaleDateString("pt-BR", { weekday: "long", day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric" });
    return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1);
  }
  function buildMessage() {
    var s = split();
    var L = ["*Pedido de Natal - Laemy Doces*", "", "*Cliente:* " + val("#f-nome"), "*Telefone:* " + val("#f-tel"), "*Forma:* " + tipo()];
    if (tipo() === "Entrega") L.push("*Endereço:* " + val("#f-end"), "*Taxa de entrega:* a combinar");
    L.push("*Data desejada:* " + fmtDate($("#f-data").value), "*Horário:* " + $("#f-per").value, "", "*Itens*");
    Object.keys(cart).forEach(function (k) {
      var X = LINES[k];
      L.push("- " + cart[k] + "x " + X.name + " (" + X.label + (X.note ? ", " + X.note : "") + ") = " + brl(X.price * cart[k]));
    });
    L.push("", "*Total:* " + brl(s.t), "*Sinal de 50% (até 10/12):* " + brl(s.sinal), "*Restante na " + (tipo() === "Entrega" ? "entrega" : "retirada") + ":* " + brl(s.rest));
    if (val("#f-obs")) L.push("", "*Observações:* " + val("#f-obs"));
    L.push("", "Aguardo a confirmação da data e as instruções para o pagamento do sinal. Obrigado!");
    return L.join("\n");
  }
  function updateWa() {
    var a = $("#wa");
    a.setAttribute("aria-disabled", count() === 0 ? "true" : "false");
    var msg = buildMessage();
    $("#msg").value = msg;
    a.href = "https://wa.me/" + CONFIG.whatsapp + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent(msg);
  }
  function setErr(id, text) {
    var e = $("#e-" + id); if (e) e.textContent = text || "";
    var w = $("#w-" + id); if (w) { if (text) w.setAttribute("data-bad", ""); else w.removeAttribute("data-bad"); }
  }
  function fmtShort(iso) { var p = iso.split("-"); return p[2] + "/" + p[1]; }
  function validate() {
    var bad = [];
    var nome = val("#f-nome"); setErr("nome", nome.length < 2 ? "Informe seu nome." : ""); if (nome.length < 2) bad.push("#f-nome");
    var digits = val("#f-tel").replace(/\D/g, ""), okTel = digits.length >= 10 && digits.length <= 13;
    setErr("tel", okTel ? "" : "Informe um telefone com DDD, por exemplo (61) 99999-9999."); if (!okTel) bad.push("#f-tel");
    if (tipo() === "Entrega") { var okE = val("#f-end").length >= 8; setErr("end", okE ? "" : "Informe o endereço completo para a entrega."); if (!okE) bad.push("#f-end"); } else setErr("end", "");
    var d = $("#f-data").value, mn = $("#f-data").min, mx = $("#f-data").max, okD = !!d && d >= mn && d <= mx;
    setErr("data", okD ? "" : "Escolha uma data entre " + fmtShort(mn) + " e " + fmtShort(mx) + "."); if (!okD) bad.push("#f-data");
    $("#e-cart").textContent = count() ? "" : "Adicione ao menos um item ao pedido.";
    if (!count()) bad.push("#close");
    return bad;
  }

  var opener = null;
  function openDrawer(from) {
    opener = from || null;
    $("#drawer").hidden = false;
    document.body.classList.add("lock");
    renderCart();
    $("#close").focus();
  }
  function closeDrawer() {
    $("#drawer").hidden = true;
    document.body.classList.remove("lock");
    if (opener && opener.focus) opener.focus();
  }
  function copyText(text, btn) {
    var done = function (ok) {
      if (!btn) return;
      var old = btn.textContent; btn.textContent = ok ? "Copiado" : "Selecione e copie";
      setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = old; }, 1800);
    };
    function fallback() {
      var ta = $("#msg");
      if (ta && text === ta.value) { var d = $("details.msg"); if (d) d.open = true; ta.focus(); ta.select(); }
      done(false);
    }
    try { navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(function () { done(true); }, fallback); } catch (e) { fallback(); }
  }

  document.addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var b = e.target.closest("[data-act]");
    if (b) {
      var k = b.getAttribute("data-key"), q = cart[k] || 0;
      setQty(k, b.getAttribute("data-act") === "inc" ? q + 1 : q - 1);
      return;
    }
    var c = e.target.closest("[data-copy]");
    if (c) copyText(c.getAttribute("data-copy"), c);
  });
  $("#open-cart").addEventListener("click", function (e) { openDrawer(e.currentTarget); });
  $("#hero-cart").addEventListener("click", function (e) { openDrawer(e.currentTarget); });
  $("#bar-btn").addEventListener("click", function (e) { openDrawer(e.currentTarget); });
  $("#close").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
  $("#scrim").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
  $("#back").addEventListener("click", closeDrawer);
  document.addEventListener("keydown", function (e) { if (e.key === "Escape" && !$("#drawer").hidden) closeDrawer(); });
  $("#clear").addEventListener("click", function () { cart = {}; sync(); persist(); });
  $("#copy-msg").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var bad = validate();
    if (bad.length) { $("#status").textContent = "Complete os campos destacados antes de copiar o pedido."; $(bad[0]).focus(); return; }
    updateWa(); copyText($("#msg").value, e.currentTarget);
  });
  $("#form").addEventListener("input", function () { updateWa(); persist(); });
  $("#form").addEventListener("change", function (e) {
    if (e.target.name === "tipo") $("#w-end").hidden = tipo() !== "Entrega";
    updateWa();
  });
  $("#form").addEventListener("submit", function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  $("#wa").addEventListener("click", function (e) {
    var bad = validate();
    if (bad.length) {
      e.preventDefault();
      $("#status").textContent = "Complete os campos destacados para enviar o pedido.";
      $(bad[0]).focus();
      return;
    }
    updateWa();
    e.currentTarget.href = "https://wa.me/" + CONFIG.whatsapp + "?text=" + encodeURIComponent($("#msg").value);
    $("#status").textContent = "O WhatsApp deve abrir em uma nova aba com o pedido escrito. Toque em enviar por lá. Se não abrir, use Copiar pedido e mande para " + CONFIG.phoneLabel + ".";
  });

  function iso(d) { return d.getFullYear() + "-" + String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0") + "-" + String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0"); }
  (function setup() {
    var today = iso(new Date());
    var f = $("#f-data"); f.min = today > CONFIG.firstDate ? today : CONFIG.firstDate; f.max = CONFIG.lastDate;
    var dl = CONFIG.depositDeadline, end = new Date(dl[0], dl[1] - 1, dl[2], 23, 59, 59);
    var days = Math.ceil((end - new Date()) / 864e5);
    var txt = "Para confirmar o pedido, pague 50% de sinal até 10/12. Os 50% restantes são pagos na entrega ou retirada.";
    if (days > 1) txt += " Faltam " + days + " dias para o prazo.";
    else if (days === 1) txt += " O prazo termina hoje.";
    else txt = "O prazo do sinal (10/12) já passou. Consulte a disponibilidade pelo WhatsApp antes de pedir.";
    $("#deadline-text").textContent = txt;
    try {
      var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || "{}");
      if (s.nome) $("#f-nome").value = s.nome;
      if (s.tel) $("#f-tel").value = s.tel;
    } catch (e) {}
  })();

  buildMenu();
  sync();
  updateWa();
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
